summary:
The Hextech kit is built, and I checked every part in screenshots. The demo page (http://127.0.0.1:5174/.superpowers/hifi/kit/demo.html) gives no console errors or warnings at 1440x900, 390x844, 768/800/1024/1280 and in reduced motion. It renders on the GPU (Intel UHD through ANGLE D3D11, headless Chrome 155). There is no horizontal scroll at 390.

Parts:

1. **tools/shoot.mjs** (playwright-core 1.65.0 installed in tools/). Uses system Chrome, falls back to Edge, launches with the GPU flags, and relaunches on SwiftShader if WebGL is missing. Flags: --times, --steps (click/hover/type/key/scroll, plus an `eval` step), --reduced-motion, --full-page, --prefix. Writes `<prefix>-<ms>.png` and `<prefix>-console.json`, prints a JSON summary with the actual capture times, and exits 1 on a page error or failed step, 2 on bad arguments. I tested it on index.html, on a page that throws, and with no arguments. In --full-page mode it scrolls through the page before each capture so offscreen WebGL and scroll reveals draw.

2. **kit/hextech.css**:
   - Tokens: gold, blue, grey, red and status scales, gradients including hover and press, and the client durations and easings.
   - Base: body #010A13, gold focus ring, 11px client scrollbars, type scale in px.
   - Components: .hx-frame (anchored 2px border, halo, gem and cap ornament strips, plus --top, --gold, --corners and a pure-CSS --chamfer variant), .hx-btn-gold with every layer (300ms border, 400ms background, 600ms glow, text pulse, 100ms press, disabled; the release layers are injected by motion.js), .hx-btn-magic (drifting teal noise texture, hover tint), main and secondary .hx-tabs, input and textarea, .hx-select, .hx-checkbox, .hx-tooltip, .hx-toast (ticks ring turns every 30s), .hx-crest (metal rim, animatable XP ring, level pill), .hx-counter, .hx-divider, .hx-modal on a native dialog, .hx-scroll-cue.
   - Extras: .hx-dot and .hx-progress, plus the header styles.

3. **kit/motion.js**: registers every named curve from the task plus the other curves in the research tables. Exports reducedMotion(), goldButtonFX() (scale .94→1 in 130ms, 330ms sheen at −5°, two corner flares 30ms apart), splitReveal() (chars rise, unblur, white glow fades, tracking settles), frameBuildIn() (a glowing gold line draws from the top centre round both sides, cools into the real border, then the strips unfold) and counterUp(). Each has a reduced-motion path.

4. **kit/sfx.js**: Web Audio only, with a generated reverb. Sounds: hover, click, select, queuePop (bell partials 1318/1976 Hz plus a noise swell), accept, lockIn (whoosh plus impact) and an ambient loop. Muted by default, the choice is kept in localStorage, and nothing plays before the first user gesture. Also exports subscribe() and wire().

5. **kit/header.js**: `<hx-header>`. 79px bar plus 1px border, 215 / fluid / 225 grid, sticky with a 12px blur.
   - PLAY is drawn in SVG to the research geometry, with a monogram "A" crest overlapping the plate by 14px. The teal swirl is feTurbulence noise shown through two dashed masks, with two blur layers, a 1500ms cycle on hover and 750ms bursts.
   - setPlayState() covers patching (fill bar, spinning ring), play, queue (wider plate, m:ss timer), found (flash) and accepted.
   - Five tabs with pop effect, three drawn icon tabs with tooltips and the 700ms glow collapse, separators, two counters, 40px crest with XP ring, sound toggle tied to sfx.
   - Below 768px: 56px bar and a drawer built like the social panel.
   - Events: hx-play, hx-nav, hx-loot, hx-playstate.

6. **kit/stage.js**:
   - createStage(): pixel budget per tier, EffectComposer with UnrealBloomPass at threshold 1.0 and OutputPass with AgX tone mapping, procedural environment lighting, tier switching on the median frame time, pauses when offscreen, one still frame in reduced motion.
   - buildHextechCore(): flat-shaded 6-sided crystal (two-sided fake glass on mid/low, real transmission on high), fbm energy sphere, fresnel halo, gold hex rings with glowing nodes, procedural rune ring plus tick dial, pointer parallax, intro().
   - buildParticles(): curl drift, gold and teal sprites.
   - buildLogo(): Simple Icons SVG to a cached extrusion with a brand-colour face (pale gold for dark brands) and gold sides.
   - buildPedestal(): stepped hex tiers, teal inlay, rotating rune ring, light pool, contact shadow, faint beam.
   - Forced high and low tiers both compile and render cleanly.

7. **kit/demo.html**: shows every component, the live header, a framed 3D core, and a pedestal stage that loads real logos (React, Angular, Spring Boot, Flutter, TypeScript, Node.js). It has buttons to replay the motion helpers, switch PLAY states and play each sound.

Bugs found and fixed through screenshots:
- The base `svg{max-width:100%}` rule shrank PLAY to 81%.
- `--hx-on` did not reach `::before`, so the active-tab pointer never showed.
- Marcellus SC's "1" reads as "I"; digits now come from Cinzel.
- The magic texture looked dirty, and the energy core blew out to white.
- Full-page captures came out black for WebGL.
- The tier dropped wrongly because screenshot stalls made long frames.
- The toast caused a 2px overflow at 390px.
- The patching fill could get a negative width.

I also added an accessible muted grey after the design linter flagged #5B5A56 captions as low contrast.
deviations_from_research: Header grid: the middle column is fluid (minmax(0,1fr)). It is exactly 840 at 1280 and wider at 1440, rather than a fixed 840 column centred in the page.

Fonts: provisional Marcellus SC (display) and Barlow (body) because the type report doesn't exist yet. Cinzel is used for digits only, because Marcellus SC's '1' is the same glyph as 'I'. It is aliased into --font-display as 'HX Digits' through unicode-range U+0030-0039, with a pinned fonts.gstatic.com Cinzel v26 URL. Counters, stats and level pills use --font-num (Cinzel 600/700).
Marcellus SC ships one weight (400), so display text gets a 0.012em text-stroke to stand in for Beaufort Bold. No faux bold (font-synthesis: none).
Added --grey-125 #8A8577 for captions, help text, placeholders and drawer status lines. The client's #5B5A56 is 2.9:1 on #010A13 and fails AA; it is kept for disabled and offline states.

Easing names follow the task: settle = 0,0,0,1 and rc-slam = .2,.9,0,1. The shell report calls .2,.9,0,1 'settle'. The other research curves are registered too: textFlash, ringIn, ringFlash, mask, slice, vignette, spinDecel, flyIn, implode, pop.

buildLogo uses path.toShapes() instead of SVGLoader.createShapes. In r187, createShapes is deprecated and logs a warning; toShapes is the fill-rule-aware replacement (confirmed by the threejs-skill report).

Energy shader tuned by eye, because the research values blew out to white under bloom: vein ridge exponent 14 (was 6), body ×0.85, veins ×2.2, fresnel ×1.4, intensity ×0.82. Halo fresnel power 5 / intensity 2.4 (was 3/2) to avoid a soap-bubble look. Bloom strength 0.7, radius 0.5.
Rune shader reads the mesh's local position instead of vUv, so the band lands correctly on RingGeometry(0.78, 0.92). Added a fine tick-dial ring (champ-select style, 90° per 60s).
Gold hex ring tube is 0.022, not 0.018 (the research allows 0.018 or more), so the rings hold up without MSAA. Six glowing teal nodes added on each ring's corners.

Fake glass: colour #6FD8DC at opacity 0.26 (research 0.28), drawn as a back-side/front-side pair, with a teal fresnel rim injected via onBeforeCompile. Crystal edges added as an additive teal line overlay.

Procedural PMREM environment lit by panels and a ring: warm key, rim, gold fill, plus a front fill so camera-facing metal reads. The teal rim was moved behind-left and lowered to 2.2, because gold reflecting teal head-on looked green.
createStage defaults to preserveDrawingBuffer: true (mockups only, noted in a code comment) so full-page screenshots keep WebGL frames.
Tier watcher steps on the median of 90-frame windows, not the average, so screenshot stalls and GC hitches don't drop the tier.

PLAY: in queue, found and accepted the plate widens from 102 to 126px with a 12px label. The queue timer sits in the header (the research marks that as our choice). The accepted state reads 'Accepted'. The patch fill starts at the crest edge so it is visible. Ornament art (tab pointer, top-strip gem, bottom-strip caps) is our own stand-in; the research marks the real art UNVERIFIED.

Magic button keeps the #111 fill and adds a faint inset teal glow at the bottom. Its animated texture is a CSS-drawn feTurbulence data URI drifting sideways (the client uses webm video). The pressed state dims the texture so the #005A82 label stays readable.
Toast is a compact 400px variant with a 104px medallion instead of the 422×135 celebration size. The entrance timings follow the research.
hx-select uses native `appearance: base-select` for the fully styled list (Chromium 135+). Other browsers show the styled trigger and a native list.
The chamfer frame variant has no halo or ornament strips, because clip-path clips them (marked as a shortcut in the CSS).
known_issues: Fonts are provisional. When docs/research/2026-11-09-type-sound-legal.md lands, update the @import, --font-display and --font-body in hextech.css.
On 1x screens at 12–14px, Cinzel's '1' flag is about 1px, so small digits can still look like 'I'. At 2x and above they are clear.
'HX Digits' points at a pinned gstatic URL (Cinzel v26 latin). If Google retires that version, digits fall back to Marcellus SC.

Only one GPU was measured: Intel UHD through ANGLE D3D11 in headless Chrome 155. It runs at 60fps and stays on the mid tier. High and low were only checked by forcing them. allowHigh() is a renderer-string check, so iGPUs and Macs stay on mid, and it may log a deprecation warning in Firefox.

With WebGL readback, each screenshot takes about 0.3–1s, so closely spaced --times drift. The summary reports the actual ms; use eval steps for precise triggers. Playwright clicks also wait for elements to be stable.
In --full-page captures, one stray pixel can appear at the pedestal canvas edge. It is a compositing artifact and does not show in viewport captures.
demo.html opens two WebGL contexts (core and pedestal). The product should use one fixed canvas (webgl report §2).
Sounds were checked to run without errors after unmuting, but nobody has listened to them (headless).

Placeholder content to confirm: 5 years (the research example; level = years), XP .62, GitHub URL https://github.com/abdelmatine guessed from the git user. The 11 projects come from projects.ts. The avatar is /public/assets/foto.jpg.
The avatar crop uses object-view-box, which only works in Chromium. Firefox and Safari show the whole photo inside the crest.

Tab glow, the modal and drawer open/close transitions, and the select picker rely on @property, @starting-style, allow-discrete and base-select. Older browsers fall back to instant changes or a native list.
The pressed magic label (#005A82) is low contrast. That is the client's value, and the state is transient.
Added one gradient-text ignore to .impeccable/config.json, scoped to kit/hextech.css (the client's measured 'promoted number' gradient).
